items.caption: A modern redraw of 路 in Shuowen seal-script style. The form is associated in the received Shuowen analysis with 足 and 各; a later commentary explicitly assigns 各 the sound role.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 路, with two looped shapes above long descending strokes.
items.selection_reason: The supplied image is legible and identified as 路 in seal-script style, making it a useful example of the received form. It does not establish a sequence of graphic changes.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not an image of an ancient artifact. The evidence does not establish a complete sequence of graphic changes leading to the modern form.
